basic_details.short_information: Central Silk Technological Research Institute, Central Silk Board (CSTRI), Bengaluru, Karnataka, has invited applications for the post of Project Associate under Advt No. No.CSB/CSTRI/Project Associate/2026-27-ES. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 17 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of the notification)

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Textile Technology, Textile & Fashion Technology, Fashion Design, Textile, Design or a related discipline
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Textile Technology; Textile & Fashion Technology; Fashion Design; Textile; Design or a related discipline from a recognized University/Institution Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of the notification) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Women 5 years, Physically Challenged 5 years, Ex-servicemen 10 years | Other conditions: | Minimum of First Class (60% marks for general; 55% for SC/ST candidates) in all classes from 10th to Masters Degree. No admission will be allowed after 12 Noon. | Desirable: | Practical proficiency in photography and videography. Hands-on knowledge of graphic design tools such as Canva and Adobe software, along with video-editing software. Ability to conduct field survey, interact with weavers and artisans, and compile data. Knowledge of textile weaving processes and traditional design techniques. Experience in field-based research, digital documentation, or working with artisans will be an advantage.

how_to_apply: Attend the walk-in interview with duly filled in application.
Bring passport size photograph, original and attested photocopies of all educational certificates from 10th Std onwards.
Ensure minimum of First Class (60% marks for general; 55% for SC/ST candidates) in all classes from 10th to Masters Degree.
Attend on 17 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to attend the interview. Position is purely temporary on contractual basis. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: CSTRI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. No.CSB/CSTRI/Project Associate/2026-27-ES gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CSTRI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Textile Technology; Textile & Fashion Technology; Fashion Design; Textile; Design or a related discipline from a recognized University/Institution Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of the notification) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Women 5 years, Physically Challenged 5 years, Ex-servicemen 10 years Other conditions: Minimum of First Class (60% marks for general; 55% for SC/ST candidates) in all classes from 10th to Masters Degree. No admission will be allowed after 12 Noon. Desirable: Practical proficiency in photography and videography. Hands-on knowledge of graphic design tools such as Canva and Adobe software, along with video-editing software. Ability to conduct field survey, interact with weavers and artisans, and compile data. Knowledge of textile weaving processes and traditional design techniques. Experience in field-based research, digital documentation, or working with artisans will be an advantage.

content_sections.heading: CSTRI Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct field surveys and visits. Documentation of the heritage. Identify, document and digitize traditional Ilkal saree designs and motifs for developing a digital heritage design library. Identify field-level problems and communicate with the weaver community. Assist in the technical assessment of existing silk handloom and preparatory processes, and support the identification and implementation of suitable technological upgradation measures. Assist in data analysis, report preparation and other project-related activities. Undertake independent travel to the project cluster and surrounding villages to accomplish assigned project objectives, as instructed by the Principal Investigator (PI)/Co-Investigator (CI).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially up to 31st March 2027, which may be extended for up to two additional years, subject to project requirements and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled in application form Passport size photograph Original and attested photocopies of all educational certificates from 10th Std (SSLC) onwards

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSTRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview with duly filled in application. Bring passport size photograph, original and attested photocopies of all educational certificates from 10th Std onwards. Ensure minimum of First Class (60% marks for general; 55% for SC/ST candidates) in all classes from 10th to Masters Degree. Attend on 17 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to attend the interview. Position is purely temporary on contractual basis. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature.
